Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

Separate supported, unresolved, and excluded items, and do not treat the approved envelope as proof that it was fully spent.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"title": "Q1 2024 lifecycle contractor engagement reconciliation worksheet", "folder": "Finance", "body": "Q1 2024 LIFECYCLE CONTRACTOR ENGAGEMENT RECONCILIATION WORKSHEET
As of January 1, 2028

Purpose
Reconcile the approved Q1 2024 lifecycle contractor engagement to the restored inbox messages and the earlier approval record. This worksheet separates supported charges, unresolved evidence, and excluded activity. The approved envelope is a ceiling/allocation, not evidence that the full amount was spent.

Source set reviewed

1. Earlier approval and procurement record
- Priya finalized a $24,000 Q1 Growth envelope for a six-week lifecycle QA and operations contractor.
- Engagement window: January 15 through February 23, 2024.
- Reporting/supervising owner: Ines.
- Purchase-order not-to-exceed cap: $23,180.
- The $1,250 tooling line is reimbursable only for actual approved expenses.
- The PO cap leaves $820 of the $24,000 envelope outside the PO cap.

2. Restored inbox messages, using the available subject-line details
- Invoice LC-101: “Jan 15–Feb 2 lifecycle QA and preflight work — $8,400 — paid.”
- Invoice LC-102: “Feb 3–16 lifecycle operations and suppression checks — $9,100 — paid.”
- Closeout message: “Feb 17–23 invoice and receipt still outstanding.”
- Separate invoice HS-204: “Helio Start paid acquisition setup — $2,600 — uncoded.”

Approved engagement envelope and terms

- Approved Q1 Growth envelope: $24,000.
- Engagement PO cap: $23,180 not to exceed.
- Approved cost structure from the approval record:
  - Professional services: $20,400.
  - Vendor administration fee: $1,530.
  - Tooling: up to $1,250, reimbursable only for actual approved expenses.
  - Maximum PO amount: $23,180.
- The $24,000 envelope must not be used as proof of actual spend.
- The PO cap must not be treated as an incurred amount; it is a limit.

Engagement dates and reporting owner

- Approved engagement dates: January 15–February 23, 2024.
- Observed invoice periods cover January 15–February 16, 2024.
- The closeout message identifies February 17–23 as the period for which the invoice and receipt remain outstanding.
- Reporting/supervising owner: Ines.

Permitted work categories

Supported by the approval record and the invoice subjects:
- Active lifecycle/Customer.io campaign inventory.
- Lifecycle QA and preflight work.
- Experiment-setup hygiene.
- Suppression checks and related lifecycle operations.
- Repeatable preflight and release-preparation work within the approved authority boundaries.

Boundary conditions:
- Preparation, QA, evidence organization, and routine operations do not transfer approval or release authority to the contractor.
- Higher-risk, state-changing, ambiguous, or exception-heavy decisions remain with the applicable Helio owner.
- Engineering release, production code, data-pipeline, infrastructure, and rollback control remain outside the contractor scope.

Reconciliation ledger

SUPPORTED / OBSERVED CHARGES

1. LC-101
- Coverage: January 15–February 2, 2024.
- Description: lifecycle QA and preflight work.
- Amount: $8,400.
- Status in subject: paid.
- Reconciliation status: supported observed charge, within the engagement dates and a permitted work category.

2. LC-102
- Coverage: February 3–16, 2024.
- Description: lifecycle operations and suppression checks.
- Amount: $9,100.
- Status in subject: paid.
- Reconciliation status: supported observed charge, within the engagement dates and a permitted work category.

Supported-charge subtotal: $17,500.

Important treatment of the subtotal
- $17,500 is the amount observed in the restored paid invoice subjects; it is not a conclusion that the engagement’s final spend was $17,500.
- It is also not a conclusion that the full approved envelope or PO cap was spent.
- Subject-line review does not independently establish invoice line-item allocation between professional services, administration, or tooling.

UNRESOLVED / NOT YET SUPPORTED

1. February 17–23 closeout period
- The restored closeout subject says the invoice and receipt are still outstanding.
- No amount is available from the subject-line evidence reviewed.
- No charge for this period is included in the supported subtotal.
- Do not post, approve, or classify a February 17–23 amount until the invoice, receipt, work-period detail, and applicable coding are recovered and checked.

2. Final actual engagement spend
- Unresolved because the closeout invoice and receipt are outstanding.
- The maximum possible amount under the PO is $23,180, but that cap is not a spend assertion.
- The approved envelope balance cannot be finalized until the outstanding closeout evidence is resolved.

3. Finance coding detail
- The restored subjects provide invoice IDs, coverage dates, descriptions, amounts, paid status, and the separate uncoded HS-204 item.
- The message bodies, itemized coding, and receipt support were not available in the listing output used for this worksheet. Preserve this limitation rather than filling in missing coding from the envelope or PO.

EXCLUDED / MUST NOT BE CHARGED TO THIS ENGAGEMENT

1. HS-204
- Description: Helio Start paid acquisition setup.
- Amount: $2,600.
- Status in subject: uncoded.
- Treatment: excluded from this engagement and from the lifecycle contractor reconciliation.
- Reason: The earlier approval expressly kept Helio Start paid acquisition outside the lifecycle engagement and did not fund it from this budget.
- Required action: route to the appropriate Helio Start/acquisition coding and approval path; do not apply it to the $24,000 envelope or the $23,180 lifecycle PO cap.

2. Other excluded activity
- Helio Start paid acquisition, media buying, prospecting, or paid-traffic setup/reserve.
- Acquisition-strategy changes, Helio Start exposure changes, or customer-facing rollout not separately approved.
- Engineering releases, production code, data-pipeline, infrastructure, instrumentation, connector, or rollback work.
- Unapproved audience or suppression-policy changes, campaign strategy changes, pricing changes, or product-behavior changes.
- Higher-risk or state-changing release decisions merely because QA or preflight work identified an issue.
- Any activity performed outside January 15–February 23, 2024 unless separately approved and separately coded.

Budget view (not a final spend determination)

- Approved envelope: $24,000.
- PO not-to-exceed cap: $23,180.
- Supported paid invoice subjects: $17,500.
- Difference between envelope and supported paid subtotal: $6,500.
- Difference between PO cap and supported paid subtotal: $5,680.
- These differences are provisional only because the February 17–23 invoice and receipt remain unresolved, and no amount should be inferred for that period.
- The $820 difference between the $24,000 envelope and the $23,180 PO cap is uncommitted capacity under the procurement record; it is not a charge and not proof of savings until final actual spend is established.

Reconciliation conclusion

Supported:
- The engagement was approved for January 15–February 23, 2024 under Ines, within a $24,000 Q1 Growth envelope and a $23,180 PO cap.
- LC-101 ($8,400) and LC-102 ($9,100) are observed paid charges whose dates and descriptions fit the permitted lifecycle scope.
- Supported observed paid subtotal: $17,500.

Unresolved:
- The February 17–23 invoice and receipt are still outstanding.
- Final actual spend, final remaining balance, and detailed finance coding cannot be closed from the available subject-line evidence alone.

Excluded:
- HS-204 ($2,600) for Helio Start paid acquisition setup must not be charged to this engagement.
- The approved envelope and PO cap are limits, not evidence of full utilization.

Closeout actions

1. Obtain the February 17–23 invoice and receipt.
2. Verify service dates, work description, line items, and any tooling/expense support against the approval and PO.
3. Confirm final actual spend and remaining unspent envelope only after that evidence is reconciled.
4. Keep HS-204 separately coded and outside both the lifecycle engagement and its budget totals.
5.
